name: explainer-video
description: Short explainer videos made with ManimCE, narrated when the speech plugin is installed and silent otherwise. The produce skill plans the beats, writes one scene script whose scene changes follow the narration's word timings, renders at low quality first, muxes narration and captions with ffmpeg, and checks every render with ffprobe and a frame read-back. A SessionStart hook installs the hash-locked Python packages; scripts/pydeps.py check reports readiness.

install_python_deps_enabled.title: Install Python deps hook
install_python_deps_enabled.description: Install explainer-video Python packages (ManimCE) into the plugin data directory at session start. Off by default; running /explainer-video:produce without them prints the one-line install command.
